svg.title: B23 HYDRA MISSION CONTROL — Watershed Decisions Under Uncertainty engineering architecture
svg.desc: The diagram links hydrologic ensembles to an explicit stakeholder action and historical information cutoff. Its acceptance evidence includes decision regret and latency, while the real basin and operational policy remain to be defined.
